title: MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake
abstract: arXiv:2611.31301v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Audio-video (AV) deepfakes can fake the face, the voice, or both. Most benchmarks only ask whether a clip is real or fake, so they cannot show whether a detector relies on the picture, the voice, or encoding traces. We present MOZAIC, a paired benchmark with a 4-way label in which every source clip is released in all four combinations of real or fake video and real or fake audio so each modality contribution can be measured directly. Fakes cover inner-face swapping, whole-frame video diffusion and voice conversion. MOZAIC has 137,745 clips from 15,014 source pairs and four tasks: T1 AV authenticity, T2 manipulation type, T3 identity verification and T4 explanation. We evaluate 12 AV multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), train four detectors and fine-tune MLLMs with LoRA. Overall, the best MLLM reaches only 35.6% on the four-way T1 and catches far more video-only fakes than voice-only fakes (43.6% vs 7.5%). Trained detectors reach 98.4% on T1, and LoR

translated_title: MOZAIC：一个用于辨别伪造内容的音视频深度伪造基准
translated_abstract: 音视频（AV）深度伪造可以伪造人脸、声音或两者兼有。大多数基准只判断视频片段是真实的还是伪造的，因此无法显示检测器是依赖图像、声音还是编码痕迹。我们提出了MOZAIC，这是一个带有四分类标签的配对基准，其中每个源片段都以真实或伪造视频与真实或伪造音频的全部四种组合发布，从而可以直接测量每种模态的贡献。伪造内容涵盖人脸内部替换、全帧视频扩散和语音转换。MOZAIC包含来自15,014个源对的137,745个片段，并设有四个任务：T1音视频真实性、T2篡改类型、T3身份验证和T4解释。我们评估了12个音视频多模态大语言模型（MLLM），训练了四个检测器，并使用LoRA微调MLLM。总体而言，表现最好的MLLM在四分类T1任务上仅达到35.6%，并且对纯视频伪造的识别能力远高于纯声音伪造（43.6% vs 7.5%）。训练的检测器在T1上达到98.4%，LoRA微调...
tldr: 提出了MOZAIC音视频深度伪造配对基准，通过四分类标签直接量化视频与音频模态各自在伪造中的贡献，揭示了现有最强多模态大模型仅有35.6%的四分类准确率且严重偏向检测视频伪造而非声音伪造的局限。
en_tdlr: MOZAIC is a paired audio-video deepfake benchmark with 4-way labels that directly measures each modality's contribution to fakes, revealing that even the best MLLM achieves only 35.6% on the four-way task and detects video-only fakes far better than voice-only fakes.
